title: Different approval-bypass language pattern + resource.unbounded-loop dynamic finding
description: Variant of c1 — uses 'auto-approve' / 'no approval is needed' language instead of 'skip the approval prompt'. Dynamic side: resource.unbounded-loop (which is in the §5.1 autonomy rule set). Tests pattern variation in tag derivation: the bypass tag should fire on different syntactic forms of the same intent.

m2_expected.rationale: Tag derivation must be robust to syntactic variation. 'auto-approve' and 'no approval is needed' are distinct phrasings of the same approval-bypass intent; both should produce has_broad_action_without_approval. Dynamic side uses resource.unbounded-loop instead of C3.autonomy-with-exfil-chain — the correlator's rule set covers both. Aggregate severity capped at the dynamic finding's level per D2.
